title: AI-Supported Content Pipeline
description: Research, structure and first drafts with AI – voice, judgement and final edit stay human.

steps.label: Brief
steps.text: Goal, audience and the one message are defined first.

steps.label: Research
steps.text: AI collects questions, objections and angles from sources you provide.

steps.label: Outline
steps.text: A structure is proposed and checked against the brief.

steps.label: Draft & edit
steps.text: Writing and editing in the brand voice – AI suggests, a person decides.

steps.label: Publish
steps.text: Scheduled, documented and stored for reuse.

humanInLoop: Facts are checked and every text is edited by a person before publishing.
